'''Threeberries''' were a type of red [[Berry/Legends|berries]] which could be found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TOR:UT" /> and when in unripe form were an ingredient in the [[Bestine threeberry pie]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" /> When eaten raw it gave the sensation of extreme dryness in the mouth, which some individuals enjoyed.<ref name="TOR:UT" />
